## Hosted regression on a dependency-update PR
PR #187 at `1d22742b2ddbb378a947c41d849bca948136e5b4` updates the three development toolchain pins from 2026.10.24 to 2026.10.25. Its current Node 22 and Node 26 jobs both report **409 tests,407 passed,2 failed,0 skipped**:
- [Node 22](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/actions/runs/40725122382/job/122946193071)
- [Node 26](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/actions/runs/40725122382/job/122946192946)

Both failures are missing-configuration read fixtures, rather than the already-tracked #184 coverage-only failure:
1. [dependency-closure.test.ts:318–339](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/1d22742b2ddbb378a947c41d849bca948136e5b4/test/dependency-closure.test.ts#L318-L339): “source isolation precedes SDK backfill for missing schema, settings and history” throws `LinearClosureRefusal(local_read_failed)` at `index.ts:2326` instead of returning a complete closure.
2. [ownership.test.ts:296–313](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/1d22742b2ddbb378a947c41d849bca948136e5b4/test/ownership.test.ts#L296-L313): “source isolation precedes SDK scaffolding even for immutable trackers and absent schema history” throws `LinearOwnershipRefusal(local_read_failed)` at `index.ts:1844` instead of a successful read-only preview.

## Static evidence and intended contract
[readClosureItems](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/1d22742b2ddbb378a947c41d849bca948136e5b4/index.ts#L2205-L2262) copies source bytes before invoking SDK reads. It explicitly repairs missing settings only in its disposable bootstrap, then unconditionally copies bootstrap/schema into the final reader. Its comments and fixtures still depend on SDK reads to backfill other missing files. The logs do not expose the underlying exception or identify which absent-path iteration failed, so the precise root cause is not established here.

The [canonical field-ownership record](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/1d22742b2ddbb378a947c41d849bca948136e5b4/.agents/pm/features/pm-linear-field-ownership.toon) requires read-only preview and complete SDK reads. Preserve that safety invariant; do not restore source mutation or assume accidental historical SDK repair side effects are a permanent contract.

## Impact and acceptance
The toolchain-update PR's current Node 22/26 and npm/Bun gates are red. This is a concrete consumer compatibility/test-contract blocker, **not evidence of source writes, data loss, or a live Linear outage**.
- Isolate each absent-path case and retain the typed underlying diagnostic in sanitized test evidence.
- Derive supported missing-configuration behavior from the current SDK contract. If disposable reconstruction is intended, use supported SDK primitives on owned copies; if refusal is intended, document and assert that explicit boundary rather than expecting incidental scaffolding.
- Keep original bytes/permissions/history unchanged and retain must-allow valid-tracker cases plus must-refuse incomplete/unsafe cases.
- Rerun current-head Node 22/26 and npm/Bun gates without weakening coverage or excluding assertions.

All 187 all-status issue/PR records, PR 187 conversation and the canonical record were checked before filing. #184 is a distinct earlier all-tests-passing coverage gap; #134 is closed complete-read lineage. Evidence here is exact hosted logs plus static source inspection; no local full-suite or live-provider execution was performed.
